name: Domain-term accuracy eval
problem: WER plus domain-term accuracy (e.g. medical terms) on public audio. Shows where general WER hides the failures that matter.
limits: Two real open ASR models on one public JFK speech clip with clean, noisy and quiet variants. Civic-domain terms are explicitly fellow americans and country; this is not a medical-ASR evaluation. Metrics count aligned term occurrences rather than presence anywhere in the transcript. The report in evidence/report.md compares every WER/term-accuracy pair. Perturbed versions are not independent speakers, and the small sample cannot rank model quality generally. Ground-truth transcript and term list are committed; source is the public openai/whisper test clip.
next: Add a licensed multi-speaker domain corpus and independently reviewed terminology annotations.
